schema.producer: producer stem (maps to <stem>_smoke.json in smoke / <stem>_values.json in full).
schema.producer_field: JSON-Pointer into that producer's JSON; segments may be a literal, a bare '*' (any non-_ dict key or list index), or a {named} segment substituted from producer_selector.
schema.producer_selector: resolves the field to EXACTLY ONE scalar. A key that names a {named} segment substitutes it; otherwise it is a field-value constraint on the *-selected record, or (if not a record field) the required *-segment key. Zero or multiple matches is a HARD FAIL.
schema.producer_kind: regression_anchor | theory_invariant | empirical_discovery -- MUST equal the producer's _taxonomy kind for that field where the producer emits _taxonomy (no conflict).
schema.manuscript_tracked: true -> a mismatch between quoted_value and the newly produced scalar sets manuscript_change_required (NONBLOCKING). false -> code-correctness/readiness claim only (not tied to current manuscript text).
schema.anchor_expected/anchor_tol/expected_sour: blocking baseline for regression_anchor/theory_invariant (full mode): new scalar must be within anchor_tol of anchor_expected.
schema.display_tol: manuscript-consistency tolerance (|quoted_value - new| ) at the printed precision.
schema.block: U-block for the full-mode completeness + DESIGNG_VALIDATE_SCOPE gating.
schema.ci_expected: for /sensitivity/ claims only: expected ci_method (none|wilson) -- the validator branches CI logic on the produced ci_method.
schema.smoke_optional: true -> the field may be absent from the producer's reduced --smoke output (fewer nu1 values / sensitivity configs / no exact-zero event); in smoke mode a zero-match on such a claim is SKIPPED_SMOKE instead of SELECTOR_ERROR. Full mode is unaffected: zero or multiple matches remain a HARD FAIL.
schema.quoted_in: map section file -> minimum number of occurrences of quoted_value pinned for that file; the validator checks EVERY listed file (main-text and Supplement tables alike; Results and Appendix tables until v27). `tex`/`line`/`manuscript_min_occurrences` describe the primary file.
schema.coverage_audit_gate: the validator refuses an audit row whose disposition cites claim:<id> unless that claim pins the row's section file (tex or quoted_in); symbolic mentions are exclusions, not claim coverage
